items.title: Jailer 2 Witnesses a Jump, Garners Rs 20 Crore in Telugu States
items.sum: Rajinikanth starrer Jailer 2 has grossed over Rs 20 crore in share collections across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. The film opened with Rs 10 crore on its first day, dipped to over Rs 5 crore on day two, and recovered to a Rs 6 crore share on day three. A distributor stated, "It has garnered Rs 6 crore share collections on day three which is good for the film to make it big." Directed by Nelson, the movie features a multi-star cast including Mohanlal, Vidya Balan, Mithun Chakraborty, and Jackie Shroff alongside Rajinikanth.
